description: This file defines the StreamPosition class, which represents a position within a stream, identified by a stream ID and a sequence token. It includes a constructor that initializes these properties and ensures the sequence token is not null.

classes.name: StreamPosition
classes.description: Represents a specific position within a stream, identified by stream ID and sequence token.

methods.name: StreamPosition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a StreamPosition with a stream ID and sequence token, throwing an exception if the sequence token is null.
